firm_data.firm_description: Robinson Yablon Cooper & Bonfante, LLP is a boutique law firm in New York City, powered by an accomplished team of trial lawyers with significant experience in handling personal injury law. Their track record has resulted in hundreds of millions of dollars awarded through both verdicts and settlements for their injured clients.
notable_facts: The firm has over 100 years of combined experience in handling personal injury law.
The firm serves all five boroughs of New York as well as Nassau and Suffolk Counties. They also serve personal injury clients in New Jersey.

email.subject: AI for Robinson Yablon Cooper & Bonfante, LLP - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Lawrence,

Your firm's track record across catastrophic accidents, auto cases, and bicycle injuries in New York speaks to the caliber of trial work you're handling, and it's the kind of complex caseload where precision matters most.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now expanding regionally. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
